summary: Frontend UI testing complete for 5 new features. All features verified working correctly: 1) Personalized greeting with patient name + appointments, 2) DiaGyn NextAvailableButton with festival gradient, 3) Doctor availability indicators, 4) Walk-in notice, 5) Status pill animations, 6) Dark/light toggle, 7) My Health tab.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 UI features tested and verified: 1) Home page greeting shows 'Good Morning/Afternoon/Evening, {patientName}' with today's appointments (doctor, time, clinic, status) when patientInfo is in localStorage 2) DiaGyn page has NextAvailableButton with festival gradient (festivalShimmer animation, multi-color gradient border) showing next available slots for both doctors 3) DiaGyn doctor cards have green/amber/red availability dot based on slots remaining 4) Walk-in notice displays when hour < 13 or >= 21 5) Status pill CSS animations defined in App.css: statusPulse (CheckedIn), statusBreathe (Booked), statusComplete (Completed) 6) Dark/light toggle visible in ServiceHeader with Sun/Moon icon 7) Bottom nav has 'My Health' tab with Heart icon linking to /health-timeline
